passage 1:Methods and strategy used to defend your castle are not the same as defending your modern day apartment or house. Castles are immense structures that could have been left very vulnerable.However, royal guards devised many plans of defense for different types of attacks. choice one would surely regret when the time came to defend your castle. Now, if the castle is located on a steep hill that rises thousands of feet high into the air, it would take considerably more effort to reach the castle and this effort would tire the invading troops.
